Method.name: UpdateAllNamespaces
UpdateAllEnsembleItems
Method.Implementation:
set itNum = 0
set prodNm = ##class(Ens.Director).GetActiveProductionName() Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("UpdateAllEnsembleItems: NAMESPACE: " _ $NAMESPACE _ ", Production: " _ prodNm)
If prodNm = "" { set itNum = ..GetItemsFromDictionary( nmSp, "IHC") } else { set itNum = ..GetItemsFromProduction(nmSp) set itNum = itNum + ..GetItemsFromDictionary( nmSp, "IHC", 1) } set itNum = itNum + ..GetIncAndRoutines(nmSp)
set itNum = itNum + ..GetLookupFiles(nmSp) set itNum = itNum + ..GetTasks(nmSp)
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("getAllEnsembleItems: "_ itNum) quit itNum

Method.name: GetItemsFromDictionary
GetIncAndRoutines
GetLookupFiles
Method.Implementation:
#dim tStat as %Status set itNum = 0 NEW $NAMESPACE SET $NAMESPACE = nmSp
&sql(Declare Cl Cursor for SELECT DISTINCT TableName into tb FROM Ens_Util.LookupTable) Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN Cl)
WHILE(SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH Cl) Quit:SQLCODE set intNm = $NAMESPACE _ "." _ tb _ ".LOOKUP" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: " _ intNm _ " in namespace: " _ $NAMESPACE) set stat = ..AddToSourceControl(intNm, nmSp, 0) if ( stat '= $$$OK) { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: returned error") return 0 } set itNum = itNum + 1 } &sql(CLOSE Cl)
return itNum

Method.Implementation:

if SQLCODE '= 0 { set stTm = "Not found" } return stTm

Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("setSources") kill ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl=$$$USRBASEDIR set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("CLS","*")="cls/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("BPL","*")="bpl/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("INC","*")="inc/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("MAC","*")="mac/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("HL7","*")="hl7/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("LOOKUP","*")="lookupTables/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("SYSDEF","*")="systemDefaults/" set ^|"ITFCOMMON"|ItfSourceCtrl("TASK","*")="tasks/" set sc=$$$OK
quit sc

Method.name: HTMLEncode
Method.Implementation: set i = 1 set newStr = "" while (i <= $L(inStr)) { set iC = $E(inStr, i, i) set newStr = newStr _ $SELECT(iC="<":"<", iC=">":">", iC="&":"&", iC="'":"'", iC="#":"#", 1:iC) set i = i + 1 } return newStr
